hypotheses.label: Preference hypothesis: shorter text
hypotheses.description: Observed joint comparisons support a conditional tendency toward shorter text relative to this population. Reference and observed widths use the same fitted pooling penalty.

support.meaning: Probability-like relative position above the pooled coefficient; conditional Gaussian approximation, not calibrated against stated values.

interval.method: Conditional Gaussian approximation; other measured features held fixed

preferenceEstimate.basis: Observed comparisons in the pinned fit. This is a conditional feature contrast, not a measured preferred life state or calibrated personal value.
